resolution: Fixed the live hmsc-int boot crash by restoring the missing CHUNK_TILES import in cart/hmsc-int/IsoPreview.tsx. IsoPreview seeds its default FreeFly camera from the chunk size, but the symbol was referenced without being imported from ./chunks, so the dev bundle threw ReferenceError: CHUNK_TILES is not defined and React remounted the preview through the error boundary. After adding the import, tools/rjit game verify is green; no commit was made.
